newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise in mid-Dec.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise in mid-Dec.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $12.43 million in the first half of December to $5.7798 billion from $5.7674 billion, according to the central bank's bimonthly balance sheet issued on Tuesday.
Gross reserves rose by $201.42 million in the second half of November to $5.7674 billion.
The gross reserves include commercial banks' foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $4.01 billion at mid-December.
Net reserves were $2.858 billion at the end of 1995 compared with $2.732 billion at the end of 1994.
